topic: For RouteKit model launches, should the gate be structured evals or 'it felt good in the demo'?
side_a: Vibes and a polished demo are enough to ship a model.
side_b: Structured evals (rubrics, labeled cases) are the launch gate; vibes are not.
reason: A conceded that structured evals beat vibes.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: If the demo felt right, ship it. Structured evals are a delay tactic. Vibes from a good operator beat a rubric.
claims: demo vibes are enough to ship

turns.speaker: caesar

turns.speaker: b
